key_policy: fixed public software-fixture key in harness; never use the research KEY
isolation: L0 shared local host; interleaved order, no CPU isolation
workload_scope: complete unlock command on deterministic 64 MiB fixture plus an authenticated empty file; fixture construction and relocking are outside the timed operation
metrics: sampled sum of RSS across child process tree, not unique physical memory or a guaranteed peak
correctness: all plaintext SHA256 digests match deterministic input manifest
stopping_rule: Stop on first failed correctness check or exceeded time limit; retain raw outcomes and use invalid/censored status. All warmups are retained.
analysis: Five observations per arm after two preset warmups; report median, observed range and paired baseline/candidate ratios. No broader speedup or frontier inference.
